description: Predicted (golden: exact periodic steady state with the simulator physics and 32-bit accumulator side, Bussgang-linear) vs simulated (analysis/sspll/sim: time-domain PLL, 2^16-sample records, erf estimator).  kP = PHOS min Re eig / same-record open-loop reference; kG = GOS slope / open-loop reference (sim normalisation keeps the regressor DC, so 12 C_GOS ~ 4 kG).

selected_columns.kP_replica: golden replica of the sim protocol
selected_columns.kP_8lam_rational: 8 x min Re eig, exact rational, ideal model
selected_columns.kP_8lam_ergodic: ergodic harmonic sum (irrational limit), min over modes

lms_note: closed-loop sign-error block LMS, real 1-bit comparator, sigma_v = 200 fs (illustrative), N = 512, 6000 blocks, 2 noise lanes, open-loop time constant 25 blocks; values in fs are of the unbounded linear model: anything above ~T_vco/8 = 7.8 ps (16 GHz illustrative) means DTC saturation / lock loss in hardware
